title: When Prices Double in a Week: Forecasting of Agricultural Volatility in Import-Isolated Markets
abstract: arXiv:2606.29248v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vegetable prices in Sri Lanka are highly volatile because the market is largely import-isolated, so supply disruptions quickly drive prices up. This study develops a machine learning framework to forecast such volatility by incorporating supply-chain-aware features and explicitly modelling the country's two cultivation seasons, Maha (October-April) and Yala (May-September). An integrated dataset was constructed by combining retail and farmer-gate prices with origin-aligned weather variables, diesel costs, and exchange rates across 12 vegetable varieties and 14 market centres from 2013 to 2019. translated_title: 当价格一周翻倍：进口隔离市场中农业波动性的预测
translated_abstract: 斯里兰卡的蔬菜价格高度波动，因为市场在很大程度上是进口隔离的，因此供应中断会迅速推高价格。本研究开发了一个机器学习框架，通过纳入供应链感知特征并明确建模该国的两个种植季节——Maha（10月至4月）和Yala（5月至9月）——来预测这种波动性。研究构建了一个综合数据集，结合了零售价格和农户门口价格，以及产地对齐的天气变量、柴油成本和汇率，覆盖2013年至2019年间的12种蔬菜品种和14个市场中心。使用Optuna训练并优化了一个梯度提升集成模型（XGBoost和LightGBM），并比较了统一配置和特定季节配置。结果表明，特定季节模型改善了季节内拟合，其中Yala特定模型达到了最高的R²为0.9420（95%置信区间[0.690, 1.000]），而统一模型则提供了更稳定的整体表现。
tldr: 本研究提出一种结合供应链特征和种植季节建模的机器学习框架，用于预测进口隔离市场中蔬菜价格的剧烈波动，其中季节特定模型显著提升了预测精度。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a machine learning framework incorporating supply-chain features and cultivation season modeling to forecast sharp vegetable price volatility in import-isolated markets, with season-specific models significantly improving prediction accuracy.
